title: Nothing’s New Headphone (1) Pro Are Made for the Studio
gist: Nothing launched the $399 Headphone (1) Pro, a $100 premium over the Headphone (1), with a three-driver design including an xMEMS silicon treble driver, a studio flat-EQ button developed with Metropolis Studio, 10-mic ANC, and nationwide Best Buy distribution in North America.

insights.claim: Nothing's Headphone (1) Pro uses three drivers per ear instead of the typical single 40-mm dynamic driver, aiming to reduce muddiness and distortion.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Multi-driver designs are a differentiation lever in a crowded premium headphone market.
insights.locator: Instead of a single dynamic driver

insights.claim: The treble driver uses xMEMS technology with a silicon diaphragm intended to render transients like cymbal hits more clearly.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Adoption of MEMS speakers in flagship consumer audio is a design win signal for xMEMS.

insights.claim: Nothing claims its best-ever active noise cancellation using 10 microphones, versus eight on Apple's AirPods Max.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Spec-level benchmarking against Apple signals a direct premium-segment challenge.

insights.claim: Battery life fell to 68 hours with ANC off from 80 on the Headphone (1), while the headphones are 2 grams lighter with glass panels that survived 18 drop tests over 1 meter.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Tradeoffs show component complexity costing battery life.
insights.locator: The Headphone (1) Pro is slightly lighter

insights.claim: At $399, the Headphone (1) Pro is a $100 premium over the standard Headphone (1), justified by targeting recording artists and audio professionals as well as consumers.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Moving upmarket tests Nothing's pricing power and brand elevation.

insights.claim: Nothing partnered with Metropolis Studio for a physical-button flat EQ mode and a 'Studio B' spatial audio mode simulating its mixing room.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Pro-studio partnerships lend credibility for premium positioning.
insights.locator: The company is including a feature

insights.claim: Nothing's chief brand officer frames the Headphone (1) Pro as a flagship to showcase capabilities and elevate the brand.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Halo products signal Nothing's ambition to compete with established premium audio brands.
insights.quote: It also helps elevate us as a brand.
insights.locator: “To us, this is a flagship product

insights.claim: The headphones go on sale September 29 via Nothing's store, Amazon and nationwide Best Buy stores across North America.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: National big-box retail distribution marks a step up in Nothing's North American reach.
